biggest_catch: Your friend must open a new OneAZ personal checking account with your promo code, make 10 qualifying debit card purchases AND complete one income/payroll direct deposit within the first 60 days; only then does your $75 deposit into your Share Savings within 15 days. If the friend's checking account is closed within 6 months, the bonus is deducted.
catches: Referrer must be an existing OneAZ member 18+ in good standing; employees, board members, and supervisory committee members are ineligible as referrers or receivers.
Friend must be a new consumer with no OneAZ account in the past 12 months; must use your promo code at account opening.

Friend must: establish membership + open a new OneAZ personal checking account, complete 10 qualifying debit card purchases (online or in-person, OneAZ debit card) within 60 days, AND complete one income/payroll ACH direct deposit within 60 days.
Your $75 is deposited into your Share Savings Account within 15 days after the friend completes all steps.
If the friend's checking account is closed within 6 months of opening, the bonus amount is deducted from the account at closing.
Bonuses are considered dividends, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT (or 1042-S); recipient responsible for taxes.
Cap: up to 10 friends ($750) per calendar year. Referred member may receive only one account opening bonus per year.
Cannot be combined with any other promotions; offer can change or be discontinued at any time without notice.
